name: ANSI/IEEE Audible buzzer form
summary: IEEE-library form of audible buzzer: a buzzer indication identifies the specified audible signalling output.
description: This reference locates audible buzzer in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous family. A buzzer indication identifies the specified audible signalling output. The public library uses HAN1Z for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

Document its energising condition and any acknowledge or silence circuit. A buzzer and a beacon provide different indication channels.
